exposure: Intermittent bolus of 0.1% levobupivacaine with fentanyl
Continuous infusion of 0.1% levobupivacaine with fentanyl
outcome: Total dose of local anesthetic required
Level of sensory and motor block
Duration of second stage of labor
cohort: 80 women with single pregnancy, cephalic presentation, and cervical dilatation of 3-5 cm during active labor.
finding: While there was no difference in the quality of analgesia or neonatal outcomes, intermittent epidural bolus of levobupivacaine with fentanyl resulted in lower total dose of local anesthetic required compared to continuous infusion.
